name: ProgramOutcomeIndicatorTracker
tagline: Your logframe, targets vs actuals and data quality in one Power Apps component – from actual entered to verified.
description: A complete results-framework (MEAL) app for nonprofits: impact, outcome and output indicators with baselines and period targets, distance-travelled achievement and RAG, a targets-vs-actuals matrix, disaggregation checks, automatic data-quality checks and manual flags, reporting deadlines, and a submit, verify, return and re-open workflow with a four-eyes check, history and undo. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Logframe of impact, outcomes and outputs
Targets vs actuals by period with RAG cells
Distance-travelled achievement for increase, decrease and maintain indicators
Automatic data-quality checks (mismatch, outlier, range, missing evidence)
Reporting deadlines, overdue and due-soon lists
Submit → verify → return / re-open with four-eyes check
Bulk submit, verify, assign and CSV export
Demo mode with 11 fictional indicators × 5 quarters
